purpose: Teach: コイツ/フラフラ/おととい/がまん/ちょこちょこ/まちまち/何時も/物凄く

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは「コイツ」じゃなくて「翔くん」って呼ぶのよ
lines.en: Sho — I'm Mei-sis to you, not "this guy."
lines.style: Warm but with a gentle edge. Soft correction, like a big sister establishing something important about how she sees him. Slow, deliberate on the name. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、運動会でフラフラになるまで走ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I ran so hard at sports day I got all wobbly.
lines.style: Small, genuine pride. Not bragging — just reporting a fact that matters to him. Quiet confidence. His voice sits a little higher with the excitement he's trying not to overflow with.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、おとといのお絵描き、可愛かったわね
lines.en: Your drawing from the day before yesterday was really cute, Sho.
lines.style: Warm, noticing tone. Not overdoing the praise — she means it simply. The kind of compliment a big sister gives when she's actually been paying attention. Soft landing on his name.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、おやつをがまんしてご飯食べるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I'm going to eat my dinner and skip the snacks like a grown-up.
lines.style: Earnest announcement. He's showing her something, not asking permission. Quiet determination. A small pause before "dinner" — he's holding onto this resolve.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがちょこちょこお仕事の電話されるのよ
lines.en: Sho — your dad gets work calls pretty often, doesn't he.
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost thinking out loud. Not worried — just noticing something she's seen. Soft, reflective rhythm. She's checking in without making a big deal of it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お友達のお弁当はまちまちで面白いよ
lines.en: My friends all bring different things in their bentos, Mei-sis — it's so interesting.
lines.style: Quiet wonder. He's noticed a pattern and wants to share it. No rush in the delivery. Small, genuine enthusiasm — the kind that comes from really looking at things.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは何時も翔くんの味方よ
lines.en: Sho — I'm always on your side. Always.
lines.style: Tender and steady. Not performed — just stated as fact. A small pause before the repetition of "always" to let it land. The voice holds him safely.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんに会えて物凄く嬉しいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I'm so incredibly happy I got to see you.
lines.style: Simple, direct joy. No filtering. His small voice carries a lot of feeling — genuine and unguarded. A slight catch on "incredibly" like the happiness caught him a little off-guard.
